description: Defines the domain model class 'LoanProductRelatedDetail' which encapsulates various properties and configurations related to loan products, including interest rates, repayment schedules, and other financial settings in the Fineract loan module.

classes.name: LoanProductRelatedDetail
classes.description: Embeddable class encapsulating detailed configurations for a loan product, including interest, repayment, schedule, and various financial options.

methods.name: createFrom
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate LoanProductRelatedDetail with specified parameters, constructing the object with provided financial and schedule settings.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns a copy of the currency associated with the loan product.

methods.name: getCurrencyData
methods.description: Returns the currency data object for external use.

methods.name: getPrincipal
methods.description: Returns the principal amount as a Money object.

methods.name: getInArrearsTolerance
methods.description: Returns the in-arrears tolerance as a Money object.

methods.name: getNominalInterestRatePerPeriod
methods.description: Returns the nominal interest rate per period, parsed from stored string.

methods.name: getInterestPeriodFrequencyType
methods.description: Returns the interest period frequency type, defaulting to INVALID if null.

methods.name: getAnnualNominalInterestRate
methods.description: Returns the annual nominal interest rate, parsed from stored string.

methods.name: getDaysInYearCustomStrategy
methods.description: Returns the custom strategy for days in a year.

methods.name: hasCurrencyCodeOf
methods.description: Checks if the currency code matches the given string.

methods.name: fetchDaysInMonthType
methods.description: Returns the days in month type enum based on stored integer.

methods.name: fetchDaysInYearType
methods.description: Returns the days in year type enum based on stored integer.

methods.name: updateForFloatingInterestRates
methods.description: Resets interest rate-related fields to indicate floating rates.

methods.name: updateInterestRecognitionOnDisbursementDate
methods.description: Sets whether interest recognition is on disbursement date.
